theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sr_linear_bootstrap
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → 0 < α → α < 1 → ∃ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ (Ω : Set (Euclid m)) (l : ℕ) (w : Euclid m → Euclid k) (B : Euclid m → ((Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k) →L[ℝ] (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k))) (g : Euclid m → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w Ω → (∀ x ∈ Ω, ‖B x‖ ≤ ε₁) → (ContDiffOn ℝ l B Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l B y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l B z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → (ContDiffOn ℝ l g Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Ω → ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ ((B x (fderiv ℝ w x) + g x) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → (ContDiffOn ℝ (l + 1) w Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l + 1) w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l + 1) w z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α)
